ValidationRule.description: A opportunity support owner cannot mark request as complete until following fields have input: Requestor’s Name, Requestor’s Country, Request Origin, Task Type, Internal Notes,Actual efforts, Estimated Completion Date
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.Name = 'Opportunity Support' , ISPICKVAL(Opportunity_Support_Status__c,"Complete"), OR( ISBLANK(Requestor_s_Name__c), ISBLANK(Requestor_s_Country__c), ISPICKVAL(Request_Origin__c,''), ISPICKVAL(Task_Type__c,''), ISBLANK(Internal_Notes__c), ISBLANK(Actual_Effort_hours__c), ISBLANK(Estimated_Complete_Date__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A opportunity support owner cannot mark request as complete until following fields have input: Requestor’s Name, Requestor’s Country, Request Origin, Task Type, Internal Notes,Actual efforts, Estimated Completion Date
